description: This file defines a trait 'Clock' and a class 'SystemClock' in the org.apache.spark.util package. The trait provides an interface for clock operations, including getting current time in milliseconds and nanoseconds, and waiting until a specified time. The class implements this interface using system calls, allowing for time mocking and precise control in Spark's internal timing mechanisms.

classes.name: SystemClock
classes.description: A concrete implementation of the Clock trait that uses system time calls to provide current time and wait functionality.

methods.name: getTimeMillis
methods.description: Returns the current system time in milliseconds since the epoch.

methods.name: nanoTime
methods.description: Returns the current value of the high-resolution time source in nanoseconds.

methods.name: waitTillTime
methods.description: Blocks execution until the system clock reaches at least the specified target time, then returns the current system time.
